title: Detailed sun
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='core' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFF7A0'/>
      <stop offset='45%' stop-color='#FFD93D'/>
      <stop offset='80%' stop-color='#FFA726'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FF8A00'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='ray1' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFE45C'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FF9E1B'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='ray2' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFD23F'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#F57C00'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- outer long rays -->
  <g stroke='#FFB300' stroke-width='3.5' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <line x1='50' y1='4' x2='50' y2='16'/>
    <line x1='50' y1='84' x2='50' y2='96'/>
    <line x1='4' y1='50' x2='16' y2='50'/>
    <line x1='84' y1='50' x2='96' y2='50'/>
    <line x1='17.5' y1='17.5' x2='25.5' y2='25.5'/>
    <line x1='74.5' y1='74.5' x2='82.5' y2='82.5'/>
    <line x1='82.5' y1='17.5' x2='74.5' y2='25.5'/>
    <line x1='25.5' y1='74.5' x2='17.5' y2='82.5'/>
  </g>

  <!-- inner shorter rays -->
  <g stroke='#FFC107' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <line x1='50' y1='19' x2='50' y2='28'/>
    <line x1='50' y1='72' x2='50' y2='81'/>
    <line x1='19' y1='50' x2='28' y2='50'/>
    <line x1='72' y1='50' x2='81' y2='50'/>
    <line x1='26' y1='26' x2='33' y2='33'/>
    <line x1='67' y1='67' x2='74' y2='74'/>
    <line x1='74' y1='26' x2='67' y2='33'/>
    <line x1='33' y1='67' x2='26' y2='74'/>
  </g>

  <!-- sun disc -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='26' fill='url(#core)' stroke='#FFE082' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- inner ring detail -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='20' fill='none' stroke='#FFCA28' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='14' fill='none' stroke='#FFE082' stroke-width='0.8' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- face -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='46' r='3' fill='#8B4513'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='46' r='3' fill='#8B4513'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='45' r='1.2' fill='#FFF7A0'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='45' r='1.2' fill='#FFF7A0'/>

  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M41 55 Q50 63 59 55' fill='none' stroke='#8B4513' stroke-width='2.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='53' r='3' fill='#FF7043' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='53' r='3' fill='#FF7043' opacity='0.5'/>
</svg>
